name: Mirako Yuuta
source:
"This year's first years aren't cute. Give your senior a little respect."

[Class] Second Year Sakuragumi (Cherry Blossom)
[Personality] Pompous, Haraguro
[Speciality] Kickboxing

A second-year delinquent. It is said that he has the abilities and strength to rival [url=/c39876]Kira[/url]. During middle school, he was a delinquent strong enough to rule the school, but all of a sudden he turned over and became an idol. He's always floating around with a grin but somewhere, on that surface, there is a deep part of him that he lets no one look deeper into.

[Translation taken from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/11/14/kenka-banchou-otome/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
